paragraphs.text: Sauruven Hellwald was a Black Knight of the Schwartzenritterein order. His master was the planeswalker Thomil .

Sauruven had narrow dark eyes and a short dark beard. He wore a steel helmet, mail hauberk, and a black tabard with crossed runic thunderbolts on his chest, carried a sharkskin-lined longsword and lindenwood shield, and rode a black stallion.

Saruven met the mourning Hurloon Minotaur Eumenes in the Gurdurngs on Dominaria . The minotaur and his mate Eurynomous had been summoned in a planeswalkers' duel and she got killed by a Stone Giant . Sauruven helped with the lamentation ritual and the two then planned to go and kill the Stone Giant. But then the knight was summoned by the planeswalker Thomil for a duel, and his new minotaur friend was summoned by the opposing planeswalker. Sauruven killed the minotaur, sang the lament for his friend, and then went and killed the Stone Giant.
